title: Fascia sealed envelope
description: ECDH P-256 (epk with the recipient's box key, x coordinate), HKDF-SHA-256 with info fascia-envelope-v1 to 32 bytes, AES-256-GCM with the canonical { to, exp } as additional data. The plaintext is canonical JSON { kind, from (sender key card), body, sig (sender device over canonical { kind, to, body }) }.
